description: Allow placed nodes/path points to move along the vertical (Bevy Y / user "z"/height) axis instead of the hardcoded y=0 plane, and make a single-point GPX track default to a plain node instead of dropping out of rendering
wave_rationale: Touches interaction (fe-ui path_point_interaction/plugin.rs) and rendering-decision code (fractalengine/gpx_bridge advance_path_materialization) that isn't gated on any not-yet-existing API; soft dependency on input_router_20260713 only for FR-1's height-modifier drag routing, not a hard blocker.
notes: User terminology: 'z-axis' = vertical/height = Bevy Y (Bevy is Y-up in this engine), not Bevy's own Z axis. FR-1 presents 3 options (height-modifier drag, numeric height field, terrain-height snapping) without deciding; recommends the height-modifier drag as lightest. FR-2 confirms gpx_points [x,y,z,t] + PathPointRow [f32;3] already support full 3D, no format change needed. FR-3 verified advance_path_materialization already gates polyline spawn on points.len() < 2, but currently does nothing for the 1-point case (silently invisible) rather than spawning a node â€” that gap is the actual FR-3 target.
